The '''Hijado system''' was located in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It was part of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hijado]].<ref name="MF" />
